description: The plot illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three different values. The x-axis is labeled “Question Popularity” and is linear, ranging from 5.0 to 25.0 with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled “Values” and is linear, ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1.  A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “Accuracy” and begins at approximately 0.24 at a question popularity of 5.0, increasing to approximately 0.94 at a question popularity of 25.0. A green line, marked with triangular data points, represents “Confidence” and begins at approximately 0.79 at a question popularity of 5.0, increasing to approximately 0.96 at a question popularity of 25.0. A red line, marked with square data points, represents “Alignment” and begins at approximately 0.53 at a question popularity of 5.0, decreasing to approximately 0.51 at a question popularity of 12.5, then increasing to approximately 0.74 at a question popularity of 25.0.
